How can I change the background color of my VOAT?

The background colour of your subverse?

There are two parts, the body element and the #container div that holds most of the page contents.

Example:

body {
 background: #f00;
}

#container {
 background: purple;
}

You could combine the rules if you want the same background colour on most of the page:

body, #container {
 background: orange;
}

Or you could make the container transparent to show through the body’s background colour:

body {
 background: green;
}

#container {
 background: transparent;
}

See also: background, background-color properties
